correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md proves a bijection between permissible (t,e), t^3=t, e^2=e, te=et=e, and e-fiber multisets of t-fixed components and two-cycle components. A nondistinguished fixed component contributes A(z), an unordered two-cycle leaf pair contributes B(z), and the outer multiset gives r3=[z^n](M(A M(A+B))-M(A M(A))). The rank-two essentiality iff each e-fiber has at most one nondistinguished t-fixed component follows from constructing/undoing a two-cycle square root. This yields the MacMahon product minus partition product and, via Gould–Grau–Johnson Proposition 4.2, m(n)=3+r2+r3 for n>=5. Independently implemented exact coefficient transforms reproduce m(5..12)=35,86,207,503,1206,2880,6808,15996 and (r3,r2) for n3..6 as (1,3),(4,8),(15,17),(46,37). No finite count is substituted for the general bijection.

value.rationale: Computes a motivated previously open exact semigroup-theoretic generator invariant for every n>=5, not a relabeling of plane partitions. Essential rank-two criterion is a reusable structural lemma and rank-three series handles arbitrary mixed fibers. This supplies exact answers for a natural infinite family.
